introduction: The campaign execution and scheduling system manages the lifecycle of campaigns — named sets of specs executed together against a shared integration branch — using a dependency DAG to sequence and parallelize spec work, cascading rebases after merges, and a REST API for campaign management. Note: requirements referencing internal/gitcmd, internal/mergequeue, and internal/gitserver APIs are based on PRD descriptions and should be cross-checked against the installed packages before implementation.

glossary.CanMerge: A function in internal/mergequeue that the campaign package implements to gate whether a spec branch may be merged, checking campaign_specs.status.
glossary.DAG: Directed Acyclic Graph of spec dependencies, where an edge from spec A to spec B means spec B cannot start until spec A has fully merged.
glossary.DeadLetter: A boolean field on MergeJob indicating the merge job exhausted all retries and entered dead-letter status, triggering spec and campaign failure.
glossary.GitRunner: The interface defined in internal/gitcmd used to execute git subprocesses (rebase, branch creation, fetch, etc.).
glossary.MergeJob: A struct defined in internal/mergequeue representing a merge queue job, including a DeadLetter bool field indicating whether the job exhausted all retries.
glossary.PostMergeHook: A callback function of type `func(ctx context.Context, job MergeJob)` defined in internal/mergequeue that the campaign scheduler implements and registers with the merge queue worker.
glossary.PushAuthorizer: A callback registered with the git server (internal/gitserver) that the campaign package uses to revoke or restore push access to spec branches.
glossary.WORKSPACE_ROOT: The filesystem root directory under which workspace clones are stored.
glossary.blocked: A per-spec status indicating the spec branch has a rebase conflict; push access is revoked and the agent must resolve the conflict before work can continue.
glossary.blocked_by_merge: The UUID of the MergeJob whose successful merge triggered the rebase conflict; stored in campaign_specs for audit purposes only, not a foreign key.
glossary.branch_name: The full git branch name for a spec within a campaign, formatted as spec/<spec_id>-<spec_name>.
glossary.branch_sha: The 40-character hex SHA of the current HEAD commit on a spec branch, stored in campaign_specs and returned in API responses.
glossary.campaign: A named execution of a set of specs against a shared integration branch within a single workspace, tracked through a lifecycle of pending → active → completed/failed/cancelled.
glossary.campaign_specs: The database table tracking per-spec status, branch info, and conflict details within a campaign (columns: campaign_id, spec_id, status, branch_name, branch_sha, conflict_details, blocked_by_merge, updated_at).
glossary.campaigns: The database table storing campaign metadata (columns: id, workspace_slug, name, integration_branch, status, dag, created_by, created_at, updated_at).
glossary.campaigns:read: An API permission scope granting read access to campaign status and DAG.
glossary.campaigns:write: An API permission scope granting write access to create, cancel campaigns, and resolve conflicts.
glossary.cascading rebase: The process of rebasing all active spec branches onto the new integration branch HEAD after each successful merge, in topological DAG order, with per-subtree conflict-stop semantics.
glossary.conflict-stop: The behavior where a rebase conflict on a spec branch halts rebasing only for that branch's downstream dependents in the DAG, leaving unrelated branches unaffected.
glossary.conflict_details: A JSON array of conflicting file path strings stored in campaign_specs.conflict_details TEXT column, serialized identically to the API response.
glossary.dag: The JSON column in the campaigns table storing the spec dependency graph as {specs: [...], edges: [{from, to, relationship}]}.
glossary.dead-letter: The state of a merge queue job that has exhausted all retry attempts, signalled to the campaign via PostMergeHook with DeadLetter=true.
glossary.depends_on_spec: A field in a tasks.json dependency entry identifying the spec ID of the upstream dependency.
glossary.explicit campaign: A campaign created with a specific list of spec_ids provided by the caller.
glossary.frontier: The set of specs in a campaign whose upstream dependencies are all satisfied (merged or pre-satisfied) and which are therefore eligible to be activated next.
glossary.implicit campaign: A campaign created without explicit spec_ids, where the hub discovers specs by scanning tasks.json files for any subtask with state=pending.
glossary.integration_branch: The shared git branch (e.g., main) against which all spec branches in a campaign are rebased and eventually merged.
glossary.internal/campaign: The Go package implementing campaign lifecycle, DAG construction, scheduling, rebase, store, authz, and REST handlers.
glossary.internal/gitcmd: The Go package (spec 10) providing the GitRunner interface for executing git subprocesses safely.
glossary.internal/gitserver: The Go package (spec 06) providing the git smart HTTP server and PushAuthorizer hook.
glossary.internal/mergequeue: The Go package (spec 11) defining the PostMergeHook interface and MergeJob struct.
glossary.sentinel: A boolean field in a tasks.json dependency entry reserved for future use; has no effect on DAG edge construction or scheduling in this iteration.
glossary.spec branch: A git branch created per spec in a campaign, named spec/<spec_id>-<spec_name>, branched from the integration branch HEAD.
glossary.spec_id: A short string identifier for a spec (e.g., '07'), used as a path parameter and in branch naming.
glossary.spec_name: The kebab-case name component of a spec branch, derived from the spec directory name by converting the snake_case suffix to kebab-case.
glossary.sync.Map: A Go standard library concurrent map used to store per-campaign mutexes keyed by campaign ID.
glossary.tasks.json: A JSON file in each spec directory at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/.agent-fox/specs/<spec_dir>/tasks.json that declares spec dependencies and subtask states.
glossary.warnings: An array of human-readable strings in the campaign creation response describing specs that were skipped due to missing or malformed tasks.json files.
glossary.workspace_slug: The URL-safe identifier for a workspace, used as a path parameter in REST endpoints and as a foreign key in campaign tables.

correctness_properties.title: DAG Acyclicity Invariant
correctness_properties.invariant: the dag column, when deserialized, represents a directed acyclic graph — no sequence of edges forms a cycle

correctness_properties.title: One Active Campaign Per Integration Branch
correctness_properties.invariant: at most one campaign with status=active exists for any given workspace_slug and integration_branch combination

correctness_properties.title: Campaign Name Uniqueness Within Workspace
correctness_properties.invariant: at most one campaign row exists with any given (workspace_slug, name) pair, regardless of status

correctness_properties.title: Frontier Specs Are Always Active
correctness_properties.for_any: spec in campaign_specs where all upstream dependencies have status=merged
correctness_properties.invariant: the spec has status=active or status=blocked or status=merged (never pending once its dependencies are satisfied and the campaign is active)

correctness_properties.title: Campaign Failure Propagation Is Immediate
correctness_properties.for_any: campaign where any campaign_specs row has status=failed
correctness_properties.invariant: the campaign's own status is also failed

correctness_properties.title: Blocked Spec Has Conflict Details
correctness_properties.invariant: conflict_details is a non-null, non-empty JSON array of file path strings and blocked_by_merge is a non-null UUID string

correctness_properties.title: Cancelled Campaign Has All Specs Cancelled
correctness_properties.invariant: every campaign_specs row for that campaign also has status=cancelled

correctness_properties.title: Atomic Campaign Creation — No Partial State
correctness_properties.for_any: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns request that returns a non-201 response
correctness_properties.invariant: no campaigns row and no campaign_specs rows are persisted, and no spec branches created during the request remain in the git repository

correctness_properties.title: Resolve Endpoint Idempotency for Active/Merged Specs
correctness_properties.for_any: POST resolve call on a spec with status=active or status=merged
correctness_properties.invariant: the response is HTTP 200 with the current status and branch_sha, and no rebase is performed

correctness_properties.title: Conflict-Stop Is Per-Subtree, Not Global
correctness_properties.for_any: cascading rebase where spec A conflicts and spec B is in an unrelated DAG subtree
correctness_properties.invariant: spec B is rebased regardless of spec A's conflict; only downstream dependents of spec A in the DAG are skipped

correctness_properties.title: Completed Campaign Has All Specs Merged
correctness_properties.invariant: every campaign_specs row for that campaign has status=merged

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns with name, spec_ids, and integration_branch
validates input, checks for active campaign on the integration branch (HTTP 409 if conflict), checks name uniqueness
reads tasks.json for each spec_id, extracts dependency edges, builds the DAG, validates acyclicity via topological sort
computes the initial frontier (specs with no unmet dependencies)
creates spec branches named spec/<spec_id>-<spec_name> from integration branch HEAD for each frontier spec
persists the campaigns row (status=active) and campaign_specs rows (frontier specs status=active, others status=pending) in a single transaction
returns HTTP 201 with campaign JSON body including status=active, dag, specs, and warnings array

execution_paths.title: Successful Merge — Cascade Rebase and Frontier Advancement

steps.action: completes a merge for a campaign spec branch and invokes PostMergeHook with DeadLetter=false
acquires the per-campaign mutex keyed by campaign ID
iterates active spec branches in topological DAG order and calls GitRunner to rebase each onto the new integration branch HEAD
for clean rebases, updates branch_sha in campaign_specs; for conflicts, sets spec to blocked, revokes push access via PushAuthorizer, records conflict_details and blocked_by_merge
marks the merged spec as merged in campaign_specs, computes newly-unblocked specs
creates spec branches for newly-unblocked frontier specs
persists all status updates and new branch records
checks if all specs are merged; if so, sets campaign status to completed; releases the mutex
exhausts all retries for a campaign spec merge job and invokes PostMergeHook with DeadLetter=true
acquires the per-campaign mutex keyed by campaign ID
sets the spec status to failed in campaign_specs
sets the campaign status to failed in campaigns
releases the mutex and returns without performing any rebase or frontier advancement
polls GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns/:id and observes status=failed

execution_paths.title: Conflict Resolution — Agent Resolves Blocked Spec Branch

steps.action: resolves the rebase conflict locally on the spec branch
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns/:id/specs/:spec_id/resolve
looks up spec in campaign_specs, confirms status=blocked
calls GitRunner to rebase the spec branch onto the current integration branch HEAD (not the blocked HEAD)
if clean: restores push access via PushAuthorizer, sets spec status to active, updates branch_sha in campaign_specs
returns HTTP 200 with {spec_id, status: active, branch_sha}
resumes pushing work to the now-unblocked spec branch

execution_paths.title: Campaign Cancellation — Soft Cancel with Branch Retention

steps.action: sends DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns/:id
validates the campaign is in active status
sets campaign status to cancelled and all campaign_specs statuses to cancelled in a single transaction
returns HTTP 200 with updated campaign JSON reflecting cancelled status
calls CanMerge for any pending merge jobs; CanMerge finds campaign_specs.status=cancelled and returns a non-nil CantMergeReason, rejecting the merge

execution_paths.title: End-to-End: Implicit Campaign Creation Through Merge Completion

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns with only name and integration_branch (no spec_ids)
scans tasks.json files at WORKSPACE_ROOT/<slug>/trunk/.agent-fox/specs/<spec_dir>/tasks.json for each spec directory
includes specs with at least one subtask with state=pending, skips missing/malformed tasks.json with warnings, builds and validates the DAG
computes the initial frontier
creates spec branches for frontier specs from integration branch HEAD
persists campaigns and campaign_specs rows; campaign status=active
returns HTTP 201 with active campaign, dag, specs, and any warnings
polls GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns?status=active and dispatches agents to active spec branches
pushes work to spec branch and submits merge request to merge queue (internal/mergequeue)
serializes and executes the merge, then invokes PostMergeHook
processes the hook: cascades rebase, advances frontier, creates new branches via GitRunner (internal/gitcmd), updates campaign_specs via campaign store
polls GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/campaigns/:id and observes status=completed when all specs are merged

error_handling.condition: POST /campaigns targets a workspace/integration_branch with an existing active campaign
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 409 with JSON body {error: string}; no campaign or spec branches are created

error_handling.condition: POST /campaigns uses a name already taken in the workspace
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 409 with JSON body {error: string}; no campaign is created

error_handling.condition: DAG construction detects a cycle in spec dependencies
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 422 with JSON body {error: string} describing the cycle; no campaign is created

error_handling.condition: Any frontier spec branch fails to be created at the git level during POST /campaigns
error_handling.behavior: delete all branches created during the request, do not persist any DB rows, return HTTP 500 (git error) or HTTP 422 (invalid input)

error_handling.condition: integration_branch does not exist in the repository at campaign creation time
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 422 with JSON body {error: string}; no campaign is created

error_handling.condition: tasks.json is malformed or unparseable during campaign creation
error_handling.behavior: skip the spec, add a warning entry to the warnings array in the HTTP 201 response; campaign creation continues for valid specs
set spec status to failed, set campaign status to failed, release per-campaign mutex, return without rebase or frontier advancement

error_handling.condition: Resolve endpoint called when spec is in pending, failed, or cancelled status
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 409 with JSON body {error: string}

error_handling.condition: Resolve endpoint rebase verification still conflicts after agent's local fix
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 409 with JSON body {conflict_details: [string]}; spec remains blocked

error_handling.condition: DELETE /campaigns/:id targets a campaign that is already completed, failed, or cancelled
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 409 with JSON body {error: string}; no state change is made

error_handling.condition: Caller lacks campaigns:read permission on a GET endpoint
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 403 with JSON body {error: string}

error_handling.condition: Caller lacks campaigns:write permission on a POST or DELETE endpoint
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 403 with JSON body {error: string}

error_handling.condition: GitRunner rebase subprocess hangs during cascading rebase
error_handling.behavior: enforce timeout, kill subprocess, treat branch as conflicted, set to blocked, continue with next branch

error_handling.condition: GitRunner rebase subprocess hangs during resolve endpoint verification
error_handling.behavior: enforce timeout, kill subprocess, return HTTP 500 without changing spec status

error_handling.condition: dag column contains malformed JSON when reading from DB
error_handling.behavior: return a non-nil error to the caller; no partial DAG is returned

error_handling.condition: All specs are skipped due to missing or malformed tasks.json, leaving an empty spec set
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 422 with JSON body {error: string} indicating no valid specs were found

symbols.name: PostMergeHook
symbols.signature: type PostMergeHook func(ctx context.Context, job MergeJob)
symbols.notes: Defined in spec 11. The campaign package implements this interface and registers it with the merge queue worker at startup.

symbols.name: MergeJob
symbols.notes: Carries DeadLetter bool field. When true, the job exhausted all retries. campaign_id field (if present) identifies the owning campaign; NULL means standalone merge.

symbols.name: CanMerge
symbols.signature: type CanMerge func(ctx context.Context, job MergeJob) (CantMergeReason, error)
symbols.notes: The campaign package implements CanMerge to reject merges for cancelled or blocked specs by checking campaign_specs.status.

symbols.name: CantMergeReason
symbols.notes: Non-empty value returned by CanMerge to reject a merge. Empty string means merge is allowed.

symbols.name: GitRunner
symbols.signature: type GitRunner interface { /* Run, RunExitCode, etc. */ }
symbols.notes: Used for all git subprocess operations: rebase, branch creation, fetch. Exact method signatures should be verified against spec 10 before implementation.

symbols.name: PushAuthorizer
symbols.signature: type PushAuthorizer func(ctx context.Context, branch string) error
symbols.notes: Callback registered with the receive-pack handler. Returns non-nil error to reject a push. Exact signature should be verified against spec 06 before implementation.
